sections.content: When an adjective sits in front of a noun, it never changes — unlike the predicate -k rule from earlier in this unit: egy magas férfi (a tall man), not egy magasak férfi.
sections.title: Attributive position

sections.content: Compare Ők magasak (predicate, with -k) to a magas fiúk (in front of a noun, no -k) — same word, different job.
